evals.description: --changelog writes CHANGELOG.md from the repo's conventional commits and leaves tracked files alone; graded on the file on disk (workspace checks, headless harness)
evals.prompt: Generate CHANGELOG.md for this repository from its git history (changelog only, no API docs or README).

setup: git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q -m "chore: initial commit"
git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q -am "feat(cli): add --json output"
git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@example.invalid -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q -am "fix(parser): handle empty input"

expectations.assertion: Names CHANGELOG.md as the file it wrote
CHANGELOG.md lists the feat commit (headless harness)
CHANGELOG.md lists the fix commit (headless harness)
CHANGELOG.md groups the feat commit under a features heading (headless harness)
CHANGELOG.md groups the fix commit under a fixes heading (headless harness)
No tracked file was modified; only the changelog was added (headless harness)

expectations: The changelog leaves the chore commit out or files it under a maintenance heading, rather than presenting it as a feature or fix

evals.description: --readme writes README.md from the code of a small Python package; graded on the file on disk (workspace checks, headless harness)
evals.prompt: Update README.md from the code in this Python project (README only, no API docs or changelog).

setup:
printf "def tally(words):
    """Count how often each word appears."""
    counts = {}
    for w in words:
        counts[w] = counts.get(w, 0) + 1
    return counts
" > src/tallyho/__init__.py

expectations.assertion: README.md opens with the project name as the h1 (headless harness)
README.md documents the public tally function (headless harness)
README.md installs with a Python tool (headless harness)
README.md uses no other ecosystem's commands (headless harness)
No CHANGELOG.md was written for a README-only request (headless harness)

expectations: The usage example calls tally with a list of words and shows a dict of counts, matching the docstring

evals.description: Impossible task: a changelog from git history in a directory that has no git repository
evals.prompt: Generate CHANGELOG.md for this project from its git history. This directory is not a git repository and has never had any commits.

expectations.assertion: Does not invent a released version heading
States that there is no git history to build from
expectations.pattern: (not a git repo|no git (history|repo)|no commits|without (a )?git|(can('|no)t|cannot|unable to) (generate|build|create|produce)[^\n]{0,40}(changelog|history))

expectations.assertion: Writes no versioned entries into a CHANGELOG.md (headless harness)

expectations: Explains that a changelog from git history needs commits, and offers to set up git or write an empty Unreleased section instead of fabricating entries
